reviewNotes: The complete thirty-eight-string lower-body clothing table is translated directly from English. Names and descriptions use concise natural Romanian inventory wording, the dinosaur extinction joke and luau party pun are retained, and each name/description pairing was reviewed in context.

Pants_Description.translation: O pereche de pantaloni care poate fi purtată.

FarmerPants_Description.source: Comfortable and durable for long hours in the field.
FarmerPants_Description.translation: Comozi și rezistenți pentru orele lungi petrecute pe câmp.

Shorts_Description.source: Perfect for a hot summer's day... your legs will thank you.
Shorts_Description.translation: Perfecți pentru o zi fierbinte de vară... picioarele tale îți vor mulțumi.

DinosaurPants_Description.source: These pants were thought to have gone extinct a long time ago!
DinosaurPants_Description.translation: Se credea că pantalonii aceștia au dispărut cu mult timp în urmă!

GrassSkirt_Description.source: A skirt made of dried grass.
GrassSkirt_Description.translation: O fustă făcută din iarbă uscată.

LuauSkirt_Description.source: A skirt destined to make you the 'luau' the party!
LuauSkirt_Description.translation: O fustă menită să te transforme în sufletul petrecerii de luau!

GeniePants_Description.source: Pants that balloon out near the bottom. Your wish has been answered!
GeniePants_Description.translation: Pantaloni care se umflă spre partea de jos. Dorința ți-a fost îndeplinită!

TightPants_Description.source: A very tight pair of pants.
TightPants_Description.translation: O pereche de pantaloni foarte mulați.

BaggyPants_Description.translation: O pereche de pantaloni cu croială largă.

SimpleDress_Description.source: A soft, smooth, medium length dress.
SimpleDress_Description.translation: O rochie moale, netedă și de lungime medie.

RelaxedFitPants_Description.source: These pants have a little more room for the legs.
RelaxedFitPants_Description.translation: Pantalonii aceștia le oferă picioarelor ceva mai mult spațiu.

RelaxedFitShorts_Description.source: These shorts have a little more room for the legs.
RelaxedFitShorts_Description.translation: Pantalonii aceștia scurți le oferă picioarelor ceva mai mult spațiu.

TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Name.translation: Pantaloni scurți mov norocoși cu bordură

TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.source: Purple silk shorts trimmed in luxurious gold...
TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.translation: Pantaloni scurți din mătase mov, împodobiți cu aur somptuos...

PrismaticPants_Description.source: Pants that shimmer with prismatic energy.
PrismaticPants_Description.translation: Pantaloni care sclipesc de energie prismatică.

PrismaticGeniePants_Description.translation: Pantaloni care sclipesc de energie prismatică.
